---
title: "Local Marine Mammals "
---

## The town of **Kaikōura is an amazing hub of marine life on the South Island due to the nearby underwater canyon that supports a unique ecosystem**

![Viewing tours from boats and helicopters](/images/IMG_1642.JPG)

### Sperm Whale:

### The sperm whales frequent **Kaikōura due to the deep water housing their prey but only the bull sperm whales come to feed.**

#### I loved seeing my first sperm whale and had an amazing crew aboard the tour boat

![One tour group to swim with them](/images/IMG_2588.PNG)

### Dusky Dolphins:

### These highly social dolphins are regularly interacted with along the **Kaikōura coast**

#### I was screaming underwater the entire time they appeared from the murky waters around me

![Recovering After Fur Trade](/images/Seal.jpg)

### New Zealand Fur Seal:

### Active measures are taken to ensure these seals are not harassed as they near populated coastlines.

#### My dad was quite close to stepping on one however
